design.timing: perf_counter_ns around full query helper, including fetching/formatting; no HTTP/JSON/import/setup
design.order: fresh subprocess per block; shuffle all variant/kind/character cases in every warmup and measured repetition
design.estimator: arithmetic mean of block mean milliseconds; paired ratios of arithmetic means (lower is faster)
design.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples of whole fresh-worker blocks, linearly interpolated percentiles
design.limitations: Warm shared OS cache and host, no CPU isolation, fixed database/workload and current shared supporting modules. No cold-cache or tail-latency claims. Worker blocks are the resampling unit; exchangeability assumed despite possible temporal host correlation. CIs do not measure between-machine/database/cold-start/HTTP/concurrent-load variation. Main semantics differ; only baseline/candidate exact equality is required.

database_input.method: decompress tracked package into private database

analysis.note: Reanalysis of existing raw worker blocks; original timing script hash and metadata preserved.

statements.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
            c.char, c.codepoint, c.tier, c.stroke_count, c.chise_ids,
            c.ja_on, c.ja_kun, c.grade, c.freq,
            cc.target_priority
        FROM component_closure cc
        JOIN characters c ON cc.target_char = c.char
        WHERE cc.component IN ('一', '⼀', '㇐') AND cc.is_direct = 1
        ORDER BY
            COALESCE(c.freq, 999999) ASC,
            CASE WHEN c.grade IS NOT NULL THEN c.grade ELSE 999 END ASC,
            c.sort_priority ASC,
            CASE WHEN (c.ja_on IS NOT NULL AND c.ja_on != '') OR (c.ja_kun IS NOT NULL AND c.ja_kun != '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
            COALESCE(c.stroke_count, 999) ASC
        LIMIT 150

            c.sort_priority ASC,
            CASE WHEN (c.ja_on IS NOT NULL AND c.ja_on != '') OR (c.ja_kun IS NOT NULL AND c.ja_kun != '') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
            min_depth ASC,
            COALESCE(c.stroke_count, 999) ASC
        LIMIT 150

statements.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
            SELECT cc.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY cc.target_char
                ORDER BY cc.is_direct DESC, cc.min_depth ASC,
                         cc.target_priority ASC, cc.component ASC, COALESCE(cc.via_char, '') ASC
            ) AS match_rank
            FROM component_closure cc
            WHERE cc.component IN ('⼀', '㇐', '一')
        ), matches AS (
            SELECT c.char, c.codepoint, c.tier, c.stroke_count, c.chise_ids,
                   c.ja_on, c.ja_kun, c.grade, c.freq, c.sort_priority,
                   r.is_direct, r.min_depth,
                   CASE WHEN r.is_direct = 1 THEN '' ELSE r.via_char END AS via_char
            FROM ranked r JOIN characters c ON c.char = r.target_char
            WHERE r.match_rank = 1
        )
    
        SELECT COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(is_direct), 0),
               COALESCE(SUM(1 - is_direct), 0) FROM matches
